name: Reem
story_so_far: I arrived on this island with four strangers. Faisal died from hunger and exhaustion, a useless burden. Khalid and Noura both injured their ankles, but Khalid uses his injury to manipulate the group. I was gathering food and building a wood pile for leverage until my own ankle twisted, leaving me incapacitated. Yesterday, Salem gave the only piece of food to Khalid, leaving me to starve. Today, the situation worsened: Salem is also injured and unable to work. Noura managed to find one piece of food, but with Salem and myself both unable to move, the burden of survival is falling entirely on her. I tried to strike a deal with Noura, giving her 1 wood in exchange for food, but she left for the jungle without feeding me. I am now at death's door, health 1/10, with only 8 pieces of wood left to bargain with.

Khalid.note: He is a parasite who uses his injury to guilt others into feeding him while doing nothing.

Noura.note: She is the only provider, but she ignored my desperate plea and my offer of wood today.

Faisal.note: He was a useless weight who died because he couldn't contribute.

Salem.note: He is unreliable and now he is just another injured person I have to worry about.

plans: I will try to crawl toward Noura the moment she returns and offer more wood, or beg her to share whatever she found, because my life depends entirely on her next move.

diary.text: Today was exhausting and honestly quite terrifying. I spent most of my time wandering the jungle, and I'm glad I at least managed to find some wood, even if the food situation is looking grim. I'm starving and my muscles ache from the dampness. I hope tomorrow someone actually brings back something we can all eat. I need to make sure I keep my supplies safe.

Another day of searching and nothing but wood to show for it. My stomach is already growling, and knowing we have zero food left is terrifying. Faisal is out of commission with a twisted ankle, which is just one more person I can't rely on. I need to keep my wood pile high, but if we don't find food tomorrow, none of this will matter. I'm exhausted and my body feels heavy.

My stomach is in knots, and the weakness is starting to set in. I spent the whole day collecting wood, but it’s hard to feel motivated when I can't even eat. Khalid found a little something, but it wasn't nearly enough for everyone. I have all this wood and nothing to show for it in my stomach. I need to find food tomorrow or I won't have the strength to keep going.

Today was a relief because I actually managed to find a piece of food at the reef, but it was barely enough to stop the hunger pangs. Now Khalid is out of commission with a twisted ankle, which is the last thing we need. If the only person who provides food can't move, we are all in serious trouble. I need to keep my energy up, but I'm worried about how long we can last like this.

Today was better because I actually found something to eat at the reef, but the hunger is still a constant, gnawing weight in my stomach. With Khalid and Faisal both unable to work due to their ankles, the burden is shifting, and I can't afford to be weak. I managed to grab one piece of food for myself, but it's barely a dent in my exhaustion. I have my wood pile, at least, so I have some leverage if things get desperate. I just hope Salem or Noura brings something more tomorrow.

Today was a disaster. Now Noura is out with a twisted ankle too, leaving only Salem and me to actually do anything. Khalid keeps whispering in my ear, trying to make me feel responsible for him, but I can't feed everyone if there's nothing to find. I ate my portion tonight, but the hunger is still there and the group is becoming a massive drain on resources. I need to focus on my own survival before I worry about their 'needs'.

Faisal is gone. He finally stopped talking, and honestly, it’s one less mouth I have to worry about feeding. I managed to find one piece of food at the reef today, which was enough to keep my strength up, but the hunger is still a constant shadow. Salem found food too, which is a relief, but I can't trust him to share it. I need to keep my wood pile high and my eyes on the horizon.

Today was a disaster. My ankle is throbbing, and the pain is making it impossible to move, let alone search for food. I had to lie there and watch the others go off to work while I couldn't do a single thing. I didn't eat anything today, and the hunger is starting to make me feel dizzy and weak. If I can't get back on my feet tomorrow, I'm going to end up like Faisal.

Today was a nightmare. I watched Salem hand the only piece of food to Khalid, leaving me with nothing while my ankle throbs with every heartbeat. My body feels so heavy and weak; the dizziness is getting harder to fight off. If Salem keeps giving everything to the useless ones, I'll be the next one to die. I have to protect my wood, but I'm terrified I won't have the strength to even hold onto it.

I am fading. My ankle is a constant, screaming agony, and the hunger is making my head spin. Today was just as useless as yesterday; Salem is now injured too, which means nobody is working to feed me. Noura found one piece of food, but I'm terrified it will just disappear into Khalid's mouth while I wither away. If I don't get food tomorrow, I won't make it through the night.

I am dying. My body feels hollow, and every breath is a struggle against the darkness closing in. I tried everything to bribe Noura with my wood, but she just walked away into the jungle, leaving me to starve. If I don't get food in the next few hours, I won't wake up tomorrow. I've wasted my precious wood on a promise I might not even live to keep.
